ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} in {FOR_possessive} room
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The nights are turning cold, and this colonist would like a fire of their own to sleep beside.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Build {THING}, or anything else with a real fire that gives off heat, inside {FOR_nameDef}'s bedroom.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has a bedroom of {PAWN_possessive} own, and it gets bitterly cold in there at night.

plain.li: I can see my breath when I wake up, and that's indoors. Could we put {THING} in my room?
[fall,evening] The nights are turning. I can feel it in my teeth. A fire in my room, before it gets worse?
[winter,night] It's the middle of the night, and I'm in bed wearing every piece of clothing I own.
[old] My joints ache all night in that cold room. A fire by the bed would ease them.
[trait:Pyromaniac] A fire in my room, please. I'd sit up and watch it every night.

warm.li: I'd keep it small and tend it myself. Just {THING}, so I'm not shivering when I wake.
[night] I lie awake listening to my own teeth chatter. A fire in my room would be such a kindness.

blunt.li: My room is a meat locker with a bed in it. Put a fire in it.
[cold] I've stopped feeling my feet. Get {THING} in my room or I'm sleeping in the kitchen.

cheerful.li: Imagine waking up warm, with a fire crackling next to the bed! Can we, please?

gloomy.li: Some morning you'll find me frozen stiff in my bed, unless someone builds {THING} in there.

cold.li: Sleeping cold costs me rest, and rest costs you work. A fire in my room fixes both.

plain.li: Slept the whole night through. Didn't once have to get up and stamp my feet warm.
[snow] Snow on the roof and a fire by my bed. I could stay in there all day.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll keep it banked and safe, and anyone who's cold is welcome to sit by it.

cheerful.li: I can feel my toes again!

gloomy.li: Warm. Huh. I'd forgotten what that was like.

cold.li: Core temperature stable through the night. Good.

plain.li: I'll sleep in my boots and coat, then, with the rug on top.

warm.li: It's alright. I'll pile on whatever I can find. There are people worse off.

blunt.li: If I freeze, I'm haunting this council first.

gloomy.li: Cold room, long winter. I'll see you in spring, if I'm lucky.

plain.li: No fire in my room yet. I've been warming my hands on my own breath.
[promised] You said there'd be a fire in my room. It's still cold in there.

blunt.li: My room. A fire. Any day now.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A reader or an artist wants somewhere proper to keep the colony's books.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other bookcase or bookshelf.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} loves books, and the colony has nowhere decent to keep them.

plain.li: Our books live in a pile by the door, and they get trodden on twice a day. Could we build {THING}?
[winter] I caught someone about to burn one of our books for warmth. They need a shelf of their own.
I've read everything we have twice. The least we can do is give it a proper home.
[rain] The roof leaks, and the books are on the floor right under the drip.
[evening] Evenings would be better with a book in hand and a shelf to put it back on.
[trait:TooSmart] I'd like {THING}. I'd also like people to walk past it and feel slightly inferior.

warm.li: If the books had a proper home, someone might pick one up on a slow evening.

blunt.li: Somebody propped up a table with a book. I know who. Build {THING} before I have words with them.

cheerful.li: A whole shelf of books, all sorted! I'd do the sorting myself, gladly.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Books are the only company here that never lets me down. They deserve better than the floor.
The books are getting damp and curling at the edges. They won't last on the floor.

cold.li: Books on the floor rot, and what's in them rots too. A shelf costs less than what we're losing.

plain.li: Spines out, titles up. Now it looks like people who think live here.

warm.li: Come and borrow anything. Bring it back, though. I'll know.

blunt.li: Next person who props a table up with a book answers to me.

cheerful.li: I've reorganized it twice already! By color, then by which ones made me cry.

cold.li: The books will last longer now, and so will what's in them.

plain.li: The books stay on the floor. Mind where you step.

warm.li: Never mind. A book's still a book, even on the floor.

blunt.li: I'm keeping the good ones under my bed. Don't ask for them.

gloomy.li: Let them rot with the rest of us.

plain.li: Someone stepped on a book again. Still no shelf.
[petition] It's not just me asking anymore. Even people who don't read want the books off the floor.

cheerful.li: I've already picked out where the bookshelf goes! Next to the window, where the light's good.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: more books to read
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The colony is short on books, and someone who loves to read has finished every one of them.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: Most of the books {FOR_nameDef} asked for are gone from the colony.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} books in storage or in the home area. Write them, buy them from traders or take them off raiders.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has read every book in the colony, some of them more than once.

plain.li: I've read our books so often I'm correcting the spelling in my head. We need new ones.
When the next trader comes through, could we look at the books before the weapons?
[skill:Artistic,night] I need stories. Somebody else's, for a change. My own are wearing thin.
[winter] Long nights and nothing new to read. I've started reading the labels on the crates.
[skill:Social,evening] I keep quoting the same three books at supper, and people have started to groan.
[trait:NightOwl] I'm up all night anyway. The nights would go faster with a book I haven't read.

warm.li: With a few more books I could read aloud in the evenings. People would like that, I think.

blunt.li: I know how every book in this colony ends. Get new ones, or get me drunk.

cheerful.li: New books, please! A cookbook, a manual, someone's old diary, I'm not picky.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] When the book ends, I have to come back here. I'd rather the books didn't end so often.
Without a new book, the evenings here are very long.

cold.li: Bored colonists start fights. I'd like {TARGET} books in storage, at least.

plain.li: New books. I'll try not to read them all tonight.

warm.li: Thank you. I've already made a list of who'd like which one.

cheerful.li: I can smell the fresh pages from here!

gloomy.li: One of these is bound to have a sad ending. I'm saving it for a bad day.

cold.li: Sufficient for now. I'll pace myself.

plain.li: The same old books again. Maybe they've changed since last time.

warm.li: It's alright. Old books are old friends.

blunt.li: Crate labels again. Riveting.

gloomy.li: I know exactly how this one ends. Like all of them.

plain.li: Still waiting on those books. I've started rereading the boring one.

cold.li: The book count remains below what I asked for.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: somewhere to train
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A fighter wants a training dummy or practice target to keep sharp between raids.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other training dummy or practice target.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is a born fighter and is going rusty between raids.

plain.li: I've been training against the wall, and my knuckles show it. Could we build {THING}?
Between raids I get slow, and then I'm slow when the raid comes.
[afterraid] I missed three times out there. Three. I want somewhere to practice before the next lot shows up.
[hurt] I got hurt because I was a step slow. I'd like to be a step faster next time.
[skill:Shooting,clear] Clear day, good light, and nothing to aim at that isn't a person or the livestock.
[skill:Melee,morning] I've been doing my morning drills against a tree stump. It isn't the same.
[trait:Bloodlust] I need something to stab between raids. Build {THING}. It's safer for the rest of you.

warm.li: I'd teach anyone who wants to learn. I just need {THING} and a corner of the yard.

blunt.li: Build me {THING}, or I start practicing on whoever annoys me most.

cheerful.li: Give me something to train on and I'll be out there every morning before breakfast!

gloomy.li: If I'm this rusty when the next raid comes, someone's going to die. Probably me.

cold.li: Practice costs some wood. A funeral costs a colonist. Build {THING}.

plain.li: I've hit it a hundred times today. My arms are shaking.

blunt.li: That's mine now. Get your own.

cheerful.li: I named it after a raider! It hasn't won a fight yet.

gloomy.li: It doesn't fight back, and raiders do. Still better than the wall.

cold.li: Practice resumes at dawn. Anyone who'd like to live longer may join.

plain.li: I'll keep sparring with the wall and the fence posts.

blunt.li: Don't come crying to me when we lose the next fight.

gloomy.li: Rusty it is. Let's hope they're rustier.

cold.li: My reaction time will degrade. Noted for the record.

plain.li: I'm still training on fence posts. They're splintering.

blunt.li: The next fight's coming, and I'm still not ready for it.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a crib for the little one
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A parent wants a proper crib for their baby, instead of whatever the baby is sleeping in now.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The crib for {FOR_nameDef}'s little one is gone.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another bed sized for a baby.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has a baby, and the baby has nowhere proper to sleep.

plain.li: The baby's been sleeping in a crate lined with an old shirt. Could we please build {THING}?
[morning] I put the little one down on a bedroll last night and found them halfway to the door this morning.
[night] I've been up four times tonight already. A proper crib might get me down to three.
[winter] The floor is freezing at night, and that's where the baby sleeps.
[afterraid] When the raid started I didn't know where to put the baby. We need somewhere safe to set them down.
[newcomer] I know we've only just arrived. The baby doesn't care. The baby needs a bed.

warm.li: I'll sand every edge smooth myself if I have to. Just help me build {THING} for the little one.

blunt.li: My child is sleeping in a box. Fix that today.

cheerful.li: A tiny bed for a tiny person! It's the most important furniture we could build.

gloomy.li: Out here a baby has enough working against it. Where it sleeps shouldn't be one of those things.

cold.li: Infants who sleep badly cry, and the crying keeps the whole room awake. A crib is the efficient answer.

plain.li: The baby slept right through. I didn't, I kept getting up to check.

warm.li: Look at that. Tiny bed, tiny blanket. Thank you, truly.

blunt.li: Baby's happy. I'm happy. We're done here.

cheerful.li: Come and see, the baby fits perfectly!

gloomy.li: That's one less thing to worry about.

cold.li: The crying should drop to tolerable levels now.

plain.li: Back in the crate, little one. Sorry.

warm.li: We'll manage. Babies have slept in worse places than this.

blunt.li: My kid sleeps in a box. Remember that next time you want something from me.

gloomy.li: Of course. Even the baby gets the leftovers.

plain.li: The baby's still sleeping in a crate. Just so you know.
[night] Up again tonight. The baby keeps rolling into the side of the crate.

warm.li: Sorry to bring up the crib again. I know there's a lot to do.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: firewood for the winter
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The cold months are here or coming, the woodpile looks thin, and someone wants it stocked before the snow.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} wood in storage or in the home area. Chop trees, or buy it from traders.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has looked at the woodpile, looked at the calendar, and done the arithmetic.

plain.li: I counted the woodpile. Then I counted the days until spring. They don't match.
We burn wood, we build with wood, and there isn't enough of it for both this winter.
[fall,day] Good weather for chopping, while it lasts. Let's get a proper woodpile in before the cold.
[winter,evening] Every fire in the colony eats from the same pile, and the pile is shrinking.
[snow] The snow's getting deep. In another week, chopping will mean wading out to the trees.
[lowtech,night] At night the fires are all that stands between us and the cold. Let's not run out of what feeds them.
[old] I've lived through a winter with the wood gone. I'm not doing it again at my age.

warm.li: I'll swing the axe myself. I just don't want anyone shivering come midwinter.

blunt.li: The woodpile's pathetic. Somebody grab an axe or we're burning the furniture by midwinter.

cheerful.li: Let's all go out and chop for a day! It's good work with a crowd doing it.

gloomy.li: First you burn the chairs, then the beds, then the doors. I've seen it happen.

cold.li: Running out of fuel in winter is how small colonies die. I'd like the pile doubled before the first hard frost.

plain.li: Now that's a woodpile. I might actually sleep tonight.

warm.li: We'll all be warm this winter. That's all I wanted.

cheerful.li: Look at it, stacked right up to the roof! I'd hug it if it weren't for the splinters.

gloomy.li: Enough wood for the winter. Probably.

cold.li: Fuel reserves adequate. Our odds of seeing spring just went up.

plain.li: I'll start working out which chair burns longest.

warm.li: We'll share the fires and huddle up. We've managed before.

blunt.li: When we're freezing, your bed goes in the fire first.

gloomy.li: The cold's coming for us, and we let it.

plain.li: The woodpile hasn't grown, and the nights keep getting colder.
[petition] I'm not the only one asking about the wood anymore.

blunt.li: Wood. Axe. Trees. I don't know how to make this any simpler.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: fodder for the animals before winter
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An animal handler wants feed stocked up before winter kills off the grazing.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} hay or kibble in storage or in the home area. Grow and cut hay, make kibble, or buy feed from traders.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} looks after the animals, and soon there will be nothing left out there for them to graze.

plain.li: The grass will be gone soon, and then the animals will start in on the crops.
Every animal we have will go hungry this winter unless we put feed away now.
[morning] There was frost on the water trough this morning. The grass won't last much longer.
[rain] The pasture's soaked, and thinner every week. We need feed put away before the frost.
[cold] The pasture's gone brown. The animals keep looking at me like it's my fault.
[afterraid] The raiders didn't get the animals. I'd hate for winter to finish the job.

warm.li: [evening] I sat with the animals after feeding. They can't ask for winter feed, so I'm asking for them.
I'll do the cutting and the hauling myself. I just don't want to watch them go thin.

blunt.li: No fodder, no animals. No animals, no milk, wool or meat.

cheerful.li: I promised the animals a cozy winter with plenty to eat! I may have spoken before checking the stores.

gloomy.li: I've watched starving animals chew through a fence to get at a field. Then they started on the barn door.

cold.li: An animal that starves over winter is bad meat by spring. Feed is cheaper than replacing the herd.

plain.li: Feed stacked to the rafters. That'll see them through.

warm.li: They'll eat well all winter. Thank you, from them too.

cheerful.li: The animals are thrilled! At least, they're chewing a lot.

gloomy.li: That's enough for an ordinary winter. We'll see what kind we get.

cold.li: The herd should come through the winter intact.

plain.li: Then I'll have to choose which animals we keep.

warm.li: I'll scrape together what I can. They'll make it. Some of them.

blunt.li: When they start eating the crops, don't look at me.

gloomy.li: Some of them won't see spring. I'll try not to name them.

plain.li: The feed's still short. The animals have started eyeing the crops.

warm.li: The animals are depending on us, even if they don't know it.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: honey in the larder
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A gourmand with a sweet tooth wants a proper stock of honey kept in storage.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} honey in storage or in the home area.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is a gourmand, and nothing the colony eats has been sweet in a long time.

plain.li: Everything we eat tastes brown. A few pots of honey would fix that.
We have about a jar's worth of honey. That isn't a stock.
[rain] Gray day, wet boots and plain bread. Honey on the bread would help.
[night] I dreamed about honey last night and woke up starving.
[morning] Porridge without honey is just wet oats. Could we keep a proper stock in the larder?
[winter] A spoonful of honey in something hot gets you through a winter evening.
[hurt] Honey on a wound and honey in hot water. My grandmother swore by both.

warm.li: Honey keeps for years, soothes a cough and fixes a bad day. Could we keep a proper stock?

blunt.li: I've seen how much honey we have. Get more.

cheerful.li: Honey on bread, honey on roast meat, honey on everything! I've got plans for it.

gloomy.li: Life out here is bitter enough. I'd like one thing in it that isn't.

cold.li: Honey doesn't spoil and it trades well. I also want to eat it.

plain.li: Honey in the larder at last. I've already had a spoonful.

blunt.li: Hands off the honey unless you ask me first.

cheerful.li: I'm not saying I'll eat it all. I'm saying I've cleared my schedule.

gloomy.li: Sweet. Too sweet for this place. I'll take it anyway.

cold.li: Good. I'll be managing the honey myself.

plain.li: Back to plain bread.

warm.li: That's alright. Plain food still fills you up.

blunt.li: Bland food for a bland colony. Fitting.

gloomy.li: No honey. I don't know why I expected any.

plain.li: The honey jar is still mostly air.

cheerful.li: Is the honey coming? I'm asking very sweetly.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a proper treasury
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A greedy colonist wants the colony's silver piled up into a real fortune, just in case.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The colony's treasury, which {FOR_nameDef} wanted kept full, has been spent down to less than half.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} silver in storage or in the home area.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is greedy and sleeps badly knowing how thin the colony's coffers are.

plain.li: Someday I'd like to walk into the storeroom and see piles of silver. Is that so much to ask?
Traders treat poor colonies like beggars. I'd like them to treat us like customers.
[poor,day] We're poor, and every trader who walks in can see it.
[rich,evening] We're doing well, I know. So why can't I see the silver pile from the door?
[afterraid] They came for our silver and found barely any. I can't decide if that's lucky or embarrassing.
[night] I count the silver before bed, and it doesn't take long.
[doubtful] I'd trust this council a lot more with a full treasury behind it.

warm.li: With real savings we could buy medicine when someone's dying, instead of just watching.

blunt.li: Stop spending silver on junk. Start piling it up. I'll guard it personally.

cheerful.li: Imagine a whole mountain of silver in the storeroom! I'd go and look at it every day.

gloomy.li: One bad season and we'll need to buy our way out of it. Right now we couldn't.

cold.li: Silver pays for ransoms, medicine and hired blades. We should have more of it.

plain.li: Now that's a treasury. I go and look at it sometimes. Just to look.

blunt.li: Anybody touches it without asking, I'll know. I counted.

cheerful.li: I counted it all twice! That's a lot of silver.

gloomy.li: Plenty of silver. Now we just need to live long enough to spend it.

cold.li: Now we negotiate from strength.

plain.li: We'll keep scraping by like peasants, I suppose.

blunt.li: Go on, spend it all on rubbish.

gloomy.li: Poor we are, and poor we'll stay.

cold.li: A missed opportunity. I've made a note of it.

plain.li: The treasury is still more of a drawer.

blunt.li: Silver. More of it. When?

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: something warm to wear
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The cold is here or coming, and this colonist owns nothing that actually keeps it out.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} wears a piece of clothing with strong cold insulation (25 or more on its own). Tailor one or buy one.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has nothing warm to wear, and the weather is turning cold.

plain.li: I'm wearing two shirts and neither of them is warm. Could someone make me a proper coat?
My clothes were made for somewhere warmer than this. I need clothes made for here.
[fall,morning] The mornings are getting sharp. A thick coat before winter comes, please.
[winter,evening] My fingers went white out there today, and it took ages to feel them again.
[snow] I came back from the fields with snow down my collar and up my sleeves.
[old] The cold gets into my bones these days. A good thick coat would help.

warm.li: Nothing fancy. Something thick, with sleeves. I'll mend it myself when it tears.

blunt.li: I'm freezing. Make me something warm or I start wearing the rug.

cheerful.li: Something warm and fluffy, maybe with a hood! I don't mind if I look ridiculous.

gloomy.li: [cold] I lose the feeling in my hands every time I go out. One day it won't come back.
I've been cold since the leaves fell. A warm coat, if anyone's handing them out.

cold.li: Cold slows the hands and dulls the mind. My output drops until I'm properly dressed.

plain.li: Warm all the way through, for once.

warm.li: Thank you. Whoever stitched this, I owe them a favor.

blunt.li: Now the cold can go and bother someone else.

cheerful.li: I look like a walking haystack and I've never been happier!

gloomy.li: I can feel my fingers again. Mixed blessing. They hurt.

plain.li: More shirts, then, one on top of the other.

blunt.li: If I lose a toe, I'm leaving it on the council's table.

gloomy.li: It'll be frostbite by midwinter.

cold.li: Expect less from me until spring.

plain.li: It's getting colder, and I've still got nothing warm to wear.

gloomy.li: I've stopped feeling my ears. That's probably fine.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a hat of {FOR_possessive} own
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: This colonist has been going bareheaded and would like something to wear on their head.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} wears a hat, hood, helmet or anything else on {PAWN_possessive} head.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has been going about bareheaded and would rather not.

plain.li: My scalp's peeling from the sun. Any hat would do.
People look more capable in a hat. I could do with some of that.
[rain] Rain's been running down the back of my neck since breakfast. Could I have something for my head?
[hot] My head's hot enough to cook on. I'd like something between it and the sun.
[snow] My ears are numb by midmorning. A hat would sort that out.
[trait:Ugly] I've been told my face is a lot. A hat would cover at least some of it.

warm.li: It doesn't have to be fancy. I'd just like something of my own to put on my head.

blunt.li: Get me a hat. My head's cold and I'm sick of people looking at my hair.

cheerful.li: I've always wanted to be a hat person! I think it would suit me.

gloomy.li: [afterraid] Raiders aim for the head. A hat won't change that. I'd still like one.
I've gone bareheaded through every season here. Next season I want a hat.

cold.li: Sun and rain on the head are avoidable discomforts. A hat is a trivial expense.

plain.li: A hat. My hat. I'm going to wear it to bed.

blunt.li: Now stop looking at my hair.

cheerful.li: Look at me, I'm a hat person now!

gloomy.li: It suits me, I think. Something should.

cold.li: Head covered. Adequate.

plain.li: Bareheaded it is. The sun can have my scalp.

blunt.li: My head's not important enough. Noted.

cheerful.li: No hat? I'll fold one out of an old shirt!

plain.li: No hat yet. My head remains on public display.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing tipping a hat I don't have yet!

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: something fine to wear
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A greedy or jealous colonist wants clothes of excellent quality or better, the kind people notice.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} wears a piece of clothing of excellent quality or better.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} wants people to notice what {PAWN_pronoun} wears, and nothing in the wardrobe is worth noticing.

plain.li: Everything I own was stitched by someone in a hurry. I'd like something stitched by someone who cared.
[evening] Some people here dress better than me at supper. I've noticed. I notice everything.
I deserve something fine. Excellent work, at least. Masterwork, if we're being honest.
[rich,morning] We have money now. I'd like to look like it.
[poor,evening] I know we're poor. That's exactly why one of us should look like we aren't.
[afterraid] If I die in the next raid, I'd like it to be in something better than this.
[skill:Social] People listen to someone well dressed. I'd get far more done in something fine.

warm.li: I know it's vain. But one really good piece of clothing would make me feel like a person again.

blunt.li: I look like a scarecrow. Get me something fine.

cheerful.li: Something beautiful to wear, with good stitching! I'd wear it to every meal.

gloomy.li: Fine clothes won't make this place any better. I'd feel better in them, though.

cold.li: Appearance shapes how others treat me. Fine clothing is a tool, and I want the tool.

plain.li: Now this is clothing. Look at the stitching. Don't touch it. Look.

blunt.li: Finally. Something worthy of me.

cheerful.li: I've been walking past everyone very slowly so they can see!

gloomy.li: Fine clothes, in all this mud. I'll try to keep them clean.

cold.li: People will take me more seriously now. Good.

plain.li: Back to the patched shirt, then.

blunt.li: I see who gets the nice things around here. Not me.

gloomy.li: Of course. Rags suit this place, and me with it.

cold.li: Disappointing. I'll remember who decides these things.

plain.li: Same patched clothes as last week. Just noting it.

blunt.li: I'm still in rags while others swan about. I've noticed.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a piece of jewelry
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: This colonist would love something pretty to wear, such as a necklace, a bracelet or a ring.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} wears a necklace, bracelet, amulet, circlet or other piece of jewelry.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} would like to wear something beautiful for once, rather than something useful.

plain.li: Everything I own is useful. Just once, give me one thing that's only pretty.
I used to wear a chain around my neck. I lost it on the way here, and I'd like another.
[spring] Spring's here and I want to feel pretty. Something small and shiny would do it.
[evening] I'd like something nice to wear in the evenings, when the work's done and nobody's bleeding.
[trait:Pretty|trait:Beautiful] People already look at me. I'd like to give them something extra to look at.
[rich,day] We've got silver lying around. Some of it could be lying around my neck instead.

warm.li: It doesn't need to be grand. Just a small piece, so I remember there's more to life than hauling.

blunt.li: I want jewelry. Don't ask why. I've earned the right to be shallow.

cheerful.li: Something sparkly, that catches the light when I move! I'd never take it off.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I want something beautiful in my life. If it has to be small enough to wear, so be it.
Nothing lasts out here except metal and stone. Let me wear a bit of the pretty kind.

cold.li: Jewelry is wealth you can carry. I also like how it looks.

plain.li: It catches the light when I turn. I keep turning.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll take good care of it. It's the nicest thing I own.

cheerful.li: Look at it! It shines differently from every side.

gloomy.li: Pretty. It'll still be shining long after I'm buried.

cold.li: A fine piece. It will hold its value.

plain.li: Nothing that shines, then. Just dirt and work clothes.

cheerful.li: That's alright! I'll find a pretty stone and tie it on a string.

gloomy.li: Pretty things aren't for people like me. I should have known.

plain.li: I keep reaching for my neck out of habit. There's still nothing there.

cold.li: The jewelry has not materialized.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: to see something of the world
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: After a month or more inside the same walls, this colonist wants to go out with a caravan and see somewhere else.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Send {PAWN_nameDef} out with a caravan, whether to trade, to visit a settlement or anywhere else.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent a long time inside these walls and wants to see what's past the hills.

plain.li: I know every rock around this colony by now.
Next time a caravan goes out, I'd like to be on it. I don't care where. Somewhere with different dirt.
[spring] The ground's drying out. It's good walking weather for a caravan.
[winter] I know it's a bad time for it. But when the weather turns, I want to be on the first caravan out.
[old] I'm not getting younger. If I'm going to see the world, it had better be before my knees give out.
[trait:Undergrounder] I don't want to leave, exactly. I want to see what's out there so I can come back and feel smug about it.

warm.li: I'd carry the packs and cook for the whole caravan. I just want to see somewhere new before I die.

blunt.li: If I look at these walls one more day I'll start punching them. Send me somewhere.

cheerful.li: A trip! New faces, new food, new roads to walk.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'll probably die in this colony. I'd like to see one other place first.
I've seen the same view every day for ages. It's not a bad view. It's just the only one.

cold.li: I'd be useful on a caravan, for trading or scouting. The change of scenery is incidental.

plain.li: I've seen another settlement now, with its own walls and its own smells.

warm.li: Thank you for letting me go. I brought back a few things for the kitchen.

blunt.li: Good trip. Bad food. Glad I went.

cheerful.li: The world is so big out there! When can I go again?

gloomy.li: It's the same out there as it is here, mud and sky and raiders. It was still good to go.

cold.li: Useful trip. Three places worth trading with, two worth avoiding.

plain.li: Maybe next year.

warm.li: That's alright. There's plenty to see here, if I look harder.

blunt.li: Same walls. Same faces. Great.

gloomy.li: I'll see the world through the cracks in the wall.

plain.li: Are any caravans going out soon? I'd still like to be on one.

cheerful.li: My bag's been packed for days! Any trip at all would do.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {SUBJECT} from {OTHER_nameDef}'s wares
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A trader is in the colony with something this colonist can't stop thinking about, and it leaves when the trader does.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Buy that very {SUBJECT} from {OTHER_nameDef} before the trader leaves.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} spotted it in the trader's packs and hasn't stopped thinking about it since.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has {THING} in those packs. I've walked past it nine times today.
We're careful with silver, I know. But that {THINGBARE} won't be here tomorrow, and I'll think about it for a year.
[evening] The trader leaves soon, and that {THINGBARE} goes too.
[poor,day] I know we're poor. I know. But have you seen {OTHER_nameDef}'s {THINGBARE}? Have you really looked?
[trait:Greedy] {OTHER_nameDef} has what I want in those packs, and I mean to have it before the trader goes.
[rain] {OTHER_nameDef} is covering the packs against the rain. I'd like that {THINGBARE} under our roof instead.
[night] The trader's camp is quiet, and that {THINGBARE} is just sitting in a pack out there.

warm.li: I never ask for things like this. But {OTHER_nameDef} has {THING}, and I'd take good care of it.

blunt.li: Buy me that {THINGBARE} before {OTHER_nameDef} packs up, or I trade my own boots for it.

cheerful.li: Did you see? {OTHER_nameDef} has {THING}, and it's perfect! Can we buy it?

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will be gone soon and the {THINGBARE} with {OTHER_objective}. Things like that don't come past here twice.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is asking too little for that {THINGBARE}. Buy it before the trader notices.

plain.li: It's mine. I keep checking it's still there.

warm.li: Thank you. I know it wasn't cheap. I'll make it worth it.

blunt.li: Good trade. It's mine, so hands off.

cheerful.li: I've shown it to everyone at supper! It's even better up close.

gloomy.li: I got it. Now I get to worry about losing it.

cold.li: A sound purchase, at a good price.

plain.li: And there it goes over the hill. Goodbye, {THINGBARE}.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} walked off with it. Thanks for nothing.

cheerful.li: Oh well! Maybe the next trader will have one.

gloomy.li: Some other colony gets it now. Lucky them.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't left yet, and neither has the {THINGBARE}.

blunt.li: The trader. The thing. Today.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_definite} hunted down
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A wild animal that mauled one of the colonists still prowls the map, and someone wants it dead.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. Mark it for hunting and send your best hunters.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} can't stop thinking about the beast that mauled one of the colony's own and is still out there.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there. Some mornings I see it at the tree line, watching us work.
Every time someone goes out to haul, I wonder if {OTHER_nameDef} is waiting for them.
[hurt] I've still got the marks {OTHER_nameDef} left on me, and it's out there walking around.
[night] It's dark and {OTHER_nameDef} is out there somewhere. I can't sleep with that thing breathing.
[skill:Shooting] Give me one clear shot at {OTHER_nameDef}. That's all I'll need.
[skill:Melee] I want to look {OTHER_nameDef} in the eye when it happens. Up close. Let me go.
[fog] Fog like this is how it got close last time. I want {OTHER_nameDef} dead before it does it again.

warm.li: I don't like killing animals. But {OTHER_nameDef} hurt one of us, and it'll do it again. Please.

blunt.li: Hunt {OTHER_nameDef} down and make a rug of it. I'll wipe my feet on it every day.

cheerful.li: Hunting party! {OTHER_nameDef} has had the run of the place long enough.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will get someone else soon, and it'll probably be me.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has learned that we're prey. Animals don't unlearn that. It has to die.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I went out and looked at the body twice.

warm.li: It's over. Thank you. I can go outside again without looking over my shoulder.

blunt.li: Somebody bring me a tooth.

cheerful.li: We got it! I'm going for a long walk, just because I can.

gloomy.li: It's dead. The scars aren't going anywhere, though.

cold.li: Threat eliminated. The meat should still be good.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} got away. It'll be back.

blunt.li: We let it walk. Next time it takes someone, that's on the council.

gloomy.li: It's gone off into the hills. It'll come back hungrier.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was at the tree line again this morning.

gloomy.li: It's still out there, and it knows what we taste like.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: lessons in {SUBJECT} from {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: This colonist loves a skill they're still bad at, and the colony's best at it is right there.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef}'s {SUBJECT} skill reaches {TARGET}. Promising pairs {PAWN_objective} with {OTHER_nameDef} as a mentor.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} loves this work but is still clumsy at it, and someone in the colony could teach {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: I love the work, I'm just bad at it. Could I learn from {OTHER_nameDef}?
{OTHER_nameDef} makes it look easy. When I try, it looks like an accident. I want lessons.
[evening] I've been watching {OTHER_nameDef} at work, trying to pick it up. I'd learn faster if {OTHER_pronoun} showed me.
[newcomer] I'm new, I know. But I want to be good at this, and {OTHER_nameDef} could show me how.
[teen] I'm young enough to learn anything, and {OTHER_nameDef} is the best we've got when it comes to {SUBJECT}.
[morning] I'd get up before dawn for it. An hour with {OTHER_nameDef} every morning, learning to do it right.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I'll put in the hours. I just need someone to tell me what I'm doing wrong.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is so good at this. If {OTHER_pronoun} could spare the time, I'd be so grateful.

blunt.li: Tell {OTHER_nameDef} to teach me. I'll ask nicely first. Once.

cheerful.li: I want to be as good as {OTHER_nameDef} one day! Even half as good would do.

gloomy.li: I'll never be as good as {OTHER_nameDef}, but I'd like to be less bad.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s knowledge dies with {OTHER_objective} unless someone learns it. I volunteer.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} showed me where I was going wrong. I'm getting it now.

warm.li: Tell {OTHER_nameDef} thank you. I'd never have gotten here on my own.

cheerful.li: I'm actually good at it now! Not great, but good.

gloomy.li: I'm better. Not good, better. I'll take better.

cold.li: Skill acquired. A good use of {OTHER_nameDef}'s time.

plain.li: I'll keep fumbling through it on my own.

blunt.li: I'll learn by breaking things.

gloomy.li: So I stay bad at the one thing I love doing.

plain.li: I'm still no better at it. {OTHER_nameDef} is still right there.

warm.li: Has anyone asked {OTHER_nameDef} about teaching me? I don't want to be a bother.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: flowers around the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: In spring and summer someone wants flowers planted around the colony, just for the look of them.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: At least {TARGET} decorative flowers are growing in the home area. Sow them in pots, flowerbeds or a growing zone.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} thinks a colony that only grows food looks like a prison farm.

plain.li: Everything we grow, we eat. Let's grow a few things just to look at.
A few flowers by the door. Somewhere for the eye to land that isn't mud or blood.
[spring,morning] It's spring everywhere except inside these walls. Let's plant some flowers.
[summer,day] The sun's out and everything's green but us. A few flowerbeds, please.
[afterraid] After this week I want to see something growing that we don't have to eat or kill.
[skill:Plants] I could put flowers in along the paths. They'd barely need tending. Let me?
[clear,evening] Lovely evening. It'd be lovelier with flowers in it.

warm.li: People would smile walking past them. I'm sure of it. Just a few flowers, here and there.

blunt.li: This place looks like a quarry. Plant some flowers before I lose my mind.

cheerful.li: Flowers! Reds and yellows and that purple kind, all along the paths.

gloomy.li: Flowers don't last, I know. I'd still like some while the weather's warm.

cold.li: Beauty lifts mood, and mood keeps people working. Flowers are cheap. Plant some.

plain.li: Flowers in our colony. Something here that's pretty on purpose.

warm.li: I saw someone stop to smell them this morning. Worth it just for that.

cheerful.li: They're blooming! I've been talking to them every morning.

gloomy.li: They'll wilt by winter. But they're here now.

cold.li: Morale should tick upward. As predicted.

plain.li: The weeds are trying their best, I suppose.

blunt.li: Enjoy your quarry.

gloomy.li: So it's mud and potatoes again.

plain.li: The flowerbeds are still just dirt.

cheerful.li: I'm still thinking about those flowers! Even one pot by the door would do.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a place to pray
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone wants an altar or shrine in the colony, a quiet place set aside for prayer.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The place to pray that {FOR_nameDef} asked for is gone.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other altar or shrine.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} needs somewhere quiet to talk to whatever might be listening.

plain.li: I've been praying behind the storeroom. It's private, but it smells of rot. Could we build {THING}?
We've made room for the living and room for the dead. Nothing for whoever's listening.
[grieving] I lost someone. I want somewhere to say their name out loud without feeling foolish.
[afterraid] We lived through that one. Somebody deserves thanks for it, and I'd like a proper place to say it.
[night] At night it gets very quiet and I feel very small. I need somewhere to go and pray.
[storm] Hear that? Somebody up there is angry. Let's build them something nice.
[trait:Nervous] I pray when I'm scared, which is always. I'd like somewhere to do it sitting down.

warm.li: It wouldn't just be for me. Anyone could sit there when things get hard.

blunt.li: I need somewhere to pray that isn't next to the latrine. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: A small shrine where people can leave a pebble or a flower! It would be lovely.

gloomy.li: There's probably no one listening. If there is, I want a proper place to complain.

cold.li: People who pray hold together better when things go wrong. A shrine is cheap for that.

plain.li: A place to kneel. I didn't know how much I needed it.

warm.li: Anyone can come and sit there, anytime. I'll keep it clean.

cheerful.li: I've said thank you there three times already, mostly for the shrine!

gloomy.li: No answer yet. At least now they know where to find me.

cold.li: People will be steadier for it.

plain.li: The storeroom it is. The gods will have to hold their noses.

blunt.li: I'll pray for patience. Mine's run out.

gloomy.li: Even the gods don't get a room here.

plain.li: Still praying behind the storeroom.

warm.li: If there's time for the shrine, whenever it suits. I know there's a lot to do.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone wants a real bath in the colony, somewhere to get properly clean and warm.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other bathtub or hot tub.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't been properly clean in a long time and can smell it.

plain.li: I wash out of a bucket. The bucket is cold, and someone keeps drinking from it.
I can smell myself from across the room, and so can the rest of you. Could we build {THING}?
[winter] Washing in cold water in winter is miserable. A hot bath would make all the difference.
[hot] It's sweltering, and we all smell like the inside of a boot. We need a bath.
[afterraid] There's still blood under my fingernails from the raid. I'd like to soak until it's gone.
[old] My back aches every morning. A long soak in hot water would quiet it down.
[rain] Mud up to the knees again. Let me sit in hot water until it's all soaked off.

warm.li: Imagine coming in at the end of the day and sinking into warm water. We'd all be kinder to each other.

blunt.li: We stink. All of us. You too. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: A real bath, with hot water! Bubbles too, if anyone knows how to make them.

gloomy.li: I'll die filthy, probably. I'd like to be clean once more before then.

cold.li: Hygiene prevents infection. A bath costs less than an infirmary full of the infected.

plain.li: I sat in there until the water went cold.

warm.li: Everyone should take a turn. I came out feeling like a new person.

blunt.li: Good. Now you can all wash.

cheerful.li: I'm so clean I squeak!

gloomy.li: Clean. For a few hours, at least.

cold.li: Hygiene will improve. So will my temper.

plain.li: Back to the bucket. Please stop drinking from it.

warm.li: It's alright. A bucket and a rag still get most of it.

blunt.li: Enjoy the smell. I'm the least of it.

gloomy.li: So we all go on smelling like this.

plain.li: Still washing out of a bucket. Someone drank from it again.
[promised] You promised a bath. I've been looking forward to it every day since.

blunt.li: The bath. You remember. The thing that would make you smell better.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} to keep meat through winter
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A cook wants a smokehouse or drying rack, so meat can be cured instead of rotting.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other smokehouse, smoker or drying rack.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} cooks, and hates watching good meat go bad before it reaches the pot.

plain.li: I threw out meat today from a kill four days old. We need {THING}.
Smoked meat keeps for months and tastes like a campfire in the best way. Let's build {THING}.
[fall] Winter's coming, and so is the hunting. We'll need somewhere to cure what we bring back.
[hot] In this heat, meat turns before I can get it into the pot. I need {THING}.
[lowtech,summer] We have no way to keep meat cold in summer. Smoke is the only thing that saves it.
[poor,evening] We can't afford to waste a scrap of meat. Smoking it means we don't have to.
[winter] The hunters come back empty-handed half the time in winter. Smoked meat would see us through.

warm.li: If we could keep meat longer, we wouldn't go hungry between hunts. I'd tend the fire every day.

blunt.li: I'm sick of burying meat. Build {THING} or start eating faster.

cheerful.li: Smoked meat, jerky, smoked fish! I've been dreaming about it.

gloomy.li: Everything rots out here sooner or later. With meat, at least, we can slow it down.

cold.li: Spoiled meat is wasted labor. A way to preserve it pays for itself in a season.

plain.li: The first batch is hanging. The smell alone is worth it.

warm.li: No more going hungry between hunts. Thank you.

cheerful.li: Everything smells like smoke now, me included! I love it.

gloomy.li: Meat that keeps. That's one problem fewer.

cold.li: Waste drops to near zero. Efficient.

plain.li: I'll keep throwing meat out to the flies.

blunt.li: Every scrap of rotten meat is on the council now.

gloomy.li: It'll all go bad. It always does.

plain.li: Threw out more meat today.

cold.li: Meat losses continue. The fix remains unbuilt.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A grower or animal lover wants bees in the colony, for the honey and for the crops.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other beehive.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} wants bees for the crops, for the honey and for the company.

plain.li: Bees would pollinate the crops and give us honey. All they'd ask for is a box and a bit of peace.
I've seen wild bees out past the fields. I think they'd move in if we built them a home.
[spring] Everything's flowering. It's the perfect time to start a hive. We're missing our chance.
[summer] Listen to that buzzing out in the fields. We could have that working for us.
[rain] Wild bees hide from rain like this. A hive of ours would keep them dry.
[morning] I'd check on a hive first thing every morning, if we had one.
[trait:Gourmand] Our own honey, as much as we like. I won't lie, that's the main reason.

warm.li: They're good little creatures, bees. They work hard and never complain.

blunt.li: Get me a hive. I'll keep the bees. You keep away from them.

cheerful.li: Thousands of tiny friends, all buzzing away! I don't even mind if they sting me.

gloomy.li: Wild bees don't last long out here. We could give a few of them somewhere safe.

cold.li: Bees produce honey and wax and demand no wages. Ideal workers. I want some.

plain.li: I can hear them working from here. Best sound in the colony.

warm.li: They've settled in. They seem happy. So am I.

cheerful.li: I've been stung twice and I've named both of them!

gloomy.li: One stung me already. Fair enough.

cold.li: Production should begin within the season.

plain.li: The flowers will have to manage on their own.

blunt.li: No hive, no honey. Remember that at supper.

cheerful.li: That's all right! I'll stand in the field and buzz encouragingly.

plain.li: Those wild bees are still out past the fields, with nowhere to go.

cheerful.li: Bee news? Anything? I'll take a rumor.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} in the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An artistic colonist wants a fountain, something beautiful and useless among all the work of staying alive.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other fountain.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} wants one beautiful, impractical thing in a colony built entirely out of necessity.

plain.li: Everything here has a purpose. I'd like one thing that's just water going up and coming down for no reason.
A fountain in the yard, where people could gather in the evenings. It would feel more like a town.
[hot] On a day like this, just the sound of water splashing would cool me down.
[afterraid] After a day like today, I want to sit by running water and forget the noise.
[evening] The evening light would look lovely on moving water. All it falls on now is mud.
[poor,day] Yes, we're poor. Yes, a fountain is useless. Poor people deserve pretty things too.
[rich,clear] We can afford beautiful things now. Let's build one where everyone can see it.

warm.li: Something for everyone to sit by. Somewhere to toss a pebble in after a bad day.

blunt.li: I want a fountain. Yes, it's useless. It would be pretty, which is more than I can say for this yard.

cheerful.li: A fountain splashing away in the yard! I'd sit and watch it every evening.

gloomy.li: We're all going to die here anyway. It might as well be somewhere with a fountain.

cold.li: A centerpiece raises the whole colony's appeal. Visitors will think we're more established than we are.

plain.li: I sat by it all through my break, and I'll do it again tomorrow.

warm.li: People stop by it now on their way past. That's what I'd hoped for.

cheerful.li: Listen to it! It sounds like it's laughing.

gloomy.li: Beautiful and useless, like a sunset.

cold.li: The colony looks more prosperous already.

plain.li: I'll listen to the rain instead, when it comes.

blunt.li: Function over beauty, forever. How inspiring.

gloomy.li: No fountain. I should have known better than to ask.

plain.li: I keep thinking about the fountain, and the sound it would make.

blunt.li: That fountain. Still useless, and I still want it.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a banner for the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone wants a banner raised over the colony, so raiders and traders alike know people live here.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The colony's banner, which {FOR_nameDef} asked for, has come down.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other banner.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} thinks the colony ought to fly colors of its own.

plain.li: Traders walk in and can't tell if we're a colony or a camp. A banner would settle that.
Every settlement worth the name flies its colors. We don't even have colors. Let's pick some and raise them.
[afterraid] We held them off. That deserves something flying over the gate.
[large,day] There are enough of us now to call ourselves a settlement. A banner would make it official.
[small,evening] We're few, but we're here. A banner says that louder than we can.
[storm] Our colors would be snapping in a wind like this, if we had any.
[newcomer] Where I come from, you knew a place by its colors. What are ours?

warm.li: Something we all share. Anyone coming home from a caravan would see it from the hills and know.

blunt.li: Raise a banner. Let raiders see whose land they're about to bleed on.

cheerful.li: A banner! We could stitch an animal on it, a fierce one with its teeth showing.

gloomy.li: When they find our ruins, there should at least be a flag on top. So they know who we were.

cold.li: A banner is a bit of cloth on a pole, and it makes outsiders think twice. Raise one.

plain.li: I saw it from the fields today and stopped work just to look at it.

blunt.li: Now they know who to fear.

cheerful.li: Our banner's up and flapping! I waved at it this morning.

gloomy.li: It'll fade in the sun and rot in the rain, but it's ours.

cold.li: Raiders scout before they strike. Now they'll see we're organized.

plain.li: We'll just be "that place over there" to everyone.

blunt.li: Stay nameless, then. See who remembers us.

gloomy.li: When we're gone, there'll be no sign of who lived here.

plain.li: Our gate's still bare. I keep picturing a banner over it.

warm.li: I've sketched some banner designs, if anyone wants to see. When there's time.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for the armory
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A fighter wants a proper weapon or armor rack, so the colony's arms can be grabbed in a hurry.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or any other weapon or armor rack.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is tired of hunting for weapons under beds every time raiders show up.

plain.li: Last raid I found my weapon under a pile of somebody's dirty socks. Could we build {THING}?
Weapons on the floor, armor in a heap. When the alarm goes, it's a scramble. I want it all on {THING}.
[afterraid] Three of us spent the start of that raid hunting for our gear.
[night] If they come tonight, I'm not sure where my weapon is.
[rain] Weapons left in a damp heap rust, and rusty weapons fail at the worst moment. Let's hang them up.
[trait:Nervous] I check where my weapon is four times a day. A rack would get me down to two.
[trait:Tough] I can take a hit. What I can't take is not finding my weapon when the hit's coming.

warm.li: I just want each of us able to grab our gear and get to the wall in time.

blunt.li: Build {THING}. The next person who leaves a weapon on the dining table loses it.

cheerful.li: A rack with all our weapons on it, gleaming! It would make this place look like a real fort.

gloomy.li: When the big raid comes, we'll lose time finding our weapons, and someone will die for it.

cold.li: Response time in a raid is measured in seconds. Organized storage buys seconds. I want it.

plain.li: Everything in its place. First time I've ever said that about this colony.

blunt.li: No excuse now for showing up to a fight empty-handed.

cheerful.li: It looks so fierce! I keep walking past it on purpose.

gloomy.li: Now at least we'll die properly equipped.

cold.li: Response time will improve. Acceptable.

plain.li: I'll keep digging under beds when the alarm goes.

blunt.li: Next time someone can't find a weapon mid-raid, I'm sending them to you.

gloomy.li: We'll scramble for weapons and lose people doing it.

plain.li: Weapons are still lying wherever people dropped them.

cold.li: The armory remains a heap.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: another sculpture for the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An artist thinks the colony could use another sculpture or statue.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {TARGET} sculptures or statues. Have an artist make {THING}, or buy one from a trader.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} is an artist, and thinks the colony's bare corners are crying out for it.

plain.li: We've got walls, floors and roofs, and nothing worth looking at. One more sculpture would help.
I'd like to carve a statue, or watch someone else carve one. Either way, we need another sculpture.
[rich,day] We're not scraping by anymore. Let's put a statue on display to show it.
[afterraid] We've cleaned up the blood. Now let's put up something worth looking at.
[evening] The common room looks so bare in the evening light. One more sculpture would catch it nicely.
[trait:TooSmart] Art is one of the few things that separates us from the squirrels. We could use more of it.

warm.li: Something we can all stop and look at. A reminder that we do more here than survive.

blunt.li: This place is ugly, and someone has to say it. Another sculpture, today if possible.

cheerful.li: I have an idea for a sculpture! A muffalo, life-size, in the middle of the dining room.

gloomy.li: [grieving] A statue will still be standing long after we're gone. I'd like one made for the people we lost.
Everything we build here is built to keep us alive. A statue would be the first thing built for looking at.

cold.li: Art raises the beauty of a room, and beauty steadies minds. One more sculpture is a modest request.

plain.li: That's a good piece. I stood in front of it longer than I meant to.

warm.li: I've seen people stop and look at it on their way to work.

cheerful.li: It's strange and beautiful, and I love it!

gloomy.li: It's lovely. It'll be the nicest thing in the ruins someday.

cold.li: Competent work. The room is improved.

plain.li: Bare walls. My eyes will adjust.

blunt.li: Keep staring at blank walls. You're good at it.

gloomy.li: No art. We just get by.

plain.li: The colony could still use another sculpture. I've a corner picked out for it.

cheerful.li: I'd love something new to look at! Any news on that sculpture?

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} to sit on outside
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone would like a bench out in the open air, somewhere to sit and watch the sky for a moment.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING} or another bench to sit on (not a workbench). Somewhere outdoors with a view is best.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} would like somewhere to sit outside that isn't a rock.

plain.li: I sit on a rock when I take a break, and my back pays for it. Could we put {THING} outside?
Just somewhere to sit outside for a minute between jobs. Somewhere that isn't the ground.
[evening] Evenings are for sitting out and watching the light go. Sitting in the mud spoils it.
[clear] Clear sky and a nice breeze, and nowhere to sit and enjoy it.
[old] My knees don't do the ground anymore. A seat outside, please.
[summer,day] It's warm enough to sit outside all evening, if there were anything to sit on.

warm.li: Somewhere to sit with someone and talk, out in the air. That's all I'm after.

blunt.li: I'm done sitting in the dirt. Put a bench outside.

cheerful.li: A bench outside! We could watch the clouds and argue about what shapes they are.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Somewhere to sit and stare at the horizon for a while. That's all.
Some days my legs give out halfway through the shift. A bench would let me rest without lying in the dirt.

cold.li: A short rest outdoors restores focus. A bench costs little. Put one by the fields.

plain.li: Sat on it this morning and watched the sun come up. Perfect.

warm.li: I saw two people sharing it last night, talking until dark. That's what it's for.

blunt.li: Good bench. Don't sit on my end.

cheerful.li: Best seat in the colony! There's room for two, three if we squeeze.

gloomy.li: A nice place to sit and wait for the end. Thank you. I mean that.

plain.li: The rock and I will have to work things out.

blunt.li: Fine. Dirt it is.

cheerful.li: Never mind! The ground is just a very long bench.

plain.li: Another break on that rock today.

gloomy.li: My back and the rock still aren't speaking.
